{"id":2000283529,"question_id":2855,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 months, 1 week","timestamp":1778482461,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/2000283529/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Maximum Number of Jumps to Reach the Last Index","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int byrec(vector<int>&nums , int i , int &target)\n    {\n        if(i == nums.size()-1) return 0;\n        if(i >= nums.size()) return -1;\n\n        int ans = -1;\n\n        for(int j = i+1 ; j<nums.size() ; j++)\n        {\n            int nextone = nums[j];\n            if(nextone - nums[i] >= -target and nextone - nums[i] <= target)\n            {\n                int nextsteps = 1 + byrec(nums , j , target);\n                if(nextsteps != 0) ans = max(ans , nextsteps);\n            }\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n\n    int maximumJumps(vector<int>& nums, int target) {\n        int ans = byrec(nums , 0 , target);\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"maximum-number-of-jumps-to-reach-the-last-index","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1989}
